name: Dosakaya Pappu
subtitle: everyday toor dal cooked down with yellow cucumber and tamarind

ingredients.qty: 200g, rinsed until the water runs clear
400g, peeled, deseeded and cut into 2cm cubes
ingredients.note: dosakaya is the squat yellow Andhra cucumber; ordinary cucumber is the closest catalogued stand-in — choose a firm one and it holds its shape
use compounded-free hing to keep this gluten-free

prepNotes: Rinse the dal in three changes of water and soak it 20 minutes — it cooks faster and creamier.
Soak the tamarind in 80ml hot water for 15 minutes and squeeze out the pulp.
Taste a raw sliver of the cucumber first; if it is bitter at the stem end, cut that part away.

steps.text: Pressure cook the dal with the cucumber, tomato, green chillies, turmeric and 600ml water for 4 whistles, then let the pressure drop naturally.
steps.tip: Add the cucumber at the start — it should be soft enough to crush, not crunchy.

steps.text: Open the cooker and mash the dal lightly against the side with the back of a ladle, leaving some cucumber cubes whole.
Stir in the tamarind pulp, chilli powder, salt and the remaining 100ml water, and simmer uncovered for 8 minutes.
steps.tip: Tamarind goes in after the dal is cooked. Added early it keeps the lentils grainy.

steps.text: Meanwhile heat the oil in a small pan and crackle the mustard seeds until they pop, about 30 seconds.
Add the cumin, dried red chillies, garlic and curry leaves and fry 1 minute until the garlic is golden and the leaves go crisp.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the asafoetida, and let it sizzle for 5 seconds.
steps.tip: Asafoetida burns instantly on direct heat. Off the flame is the only safe moment.

steps.text: Pour the tempering into the dal, add the raw onion if using, and simmer 2 minutes more.
Finish with the coriander leaves and check the salt — it should taste sour, then hot, then savoury.

storage: Keeps 3 days refrigerated. It thickens a lot as it sits; loosen with hot water when reheating and simmer 2 minutes so it comes back together. Do not freeze.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
nutrition.caveat: Ingredients given to taste rather than by weight are counted as zero, so the real figure is a little higher than this. The + says so.
